articles.title_zh: Trump rejects Iran deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
facts_zh:
Trump rejects Iran deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
- Published
US President Donald Trump has rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to commercial shipping within a week.
He told reporters at the White House that Tehran "want to make a deal where they open the Strait immediately because they're losing so badly".
In a post on Telegram, Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi acknowledged Trump's comments, but said Tehran would wait for an official response from mediators.

all_titles.en: Trump rejects Iran deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days

articles.title_original: Nor'easter brings flooding as New York and New Jersey declare emergency
articles.title_zh: Nor'easter brings flooding as New York and New Jersey declare emergency
facts_zh:
Nor'easter brings flooding as New York and New Jersey declare emergency
- Published
Tens of millions of people across the north-eastern US are in the path of a powerful storm bringing coastal flooding, power cuts, travel chaos and cancelled stadium events.

The so-called nor'easter is bringing "dangerous coastal flooding and beach conditions, strong winds and heavy rainfall" to areas including New York City and Boston on Saturday, the US National Weather Service (NWS) said.
States of emergency have been declared in New York and New Jersey, both of which faced a coastal deluge in some areas.

all_titles.en: Nor'easter brings flooding as New York and New Jersey declare emergency

articles.title_original: Mother of woman found hanging in tree shocked as police say body was staged
articles.title_zh: Mother of woman found hanging in tree shocked as police say body was staged
facts_zh:
Mother of woman found hanging in tree shocked as police say body was staged
- Published
Warning: This story contains distressing details
The mother of a woman found hanging in a tree in Mississippi has spoken of her shock after authorities said they believed her daughter was dead before her body was placed at the allegedly "staged" crime scene.
Tasia Fortune, a 29-year-old mother of four, was found hanging from a tree at an abandoned home in Jackson in August.
The discovery sparked widespread fears in the majority-black city because of the state's deep history of racial violence and lynchings.

all_titles.en: Mother of woman found hanging in tree shocked as police say body was staged

Republic of Ireland players intend to wear black armbands "in recognition of all lives lost in the [Gaza] conflict" for Sunday's Nations League game against Israel in Hungary, after confirming they will go ahead with the fixture.
Football Association of Ireland (FAI) chief executive David Courell confirmed one player has withdrawn from the squad before the match.

articles.title_zh: White House bars CNN from travelling with Trump on Air Force One
facts_zh:
White House bars CNN from travelling with Trump on Air Force One
- Published
Broadcaster CNN has been barred from travelling with US President Donald Trump on Air Force One for a trip to Tennessee on Saturday.
The move is the latest in a battle between the White House and the media after it was forced to lift its ban on some news outlets.

CNN was scheduled to fly with Trump for his trip to Tennessee for a college American football game until a note released on Friday night by the White House did not list the broadcaster on the media schedule.

all_titles.en: White House bars CNN from travelling with Trump on Air Force One

articles.title_original: Tenth woman's body found as South Africa police probe killings
articles.title_zh: Tenth woman's body found as South Africa police probe killings
facts_zh:
Tenth woman's body found as South Africa police probe killings
- Published
Police in South Africa say they have discovered another body in Ekurhuleni, to the east of Johannesburg, bringing the number of women found dead there in recent months to 10.
The body was found on Saturday morning and was identified by the friend with whom she had been at a bar the previous evening.

The local police commissioner said his force could not rule out the possibility that there was a serial killer on the loose, noting similarities across the 10 deaths in Ekurhuleni, as well as another in Soweto.

all_titles.en: Tenth woman's body found as South Africa police probe killings

articles.title_original: German town bans 'stumbling stone' memorials to Nazi victims
articles.title_zh: German town bans 'stumbling stone' memorials to Nazi victims
facts_zh:
German town bans 'stumbling stone' memorials to Nazi victims
- Published
There has been a wave of criticism in Germany after the town of Heidenau, near Dresden in Saxony, decided to ban "stumbling stone" memorials to victims of the Nazis.
Germany's Education Minister Karin Prien told newspaper Bild that the ban was a "scandal".
Since the 1990s, many towns in countries across Europe, including in Germany and Austria, have embedded small brass plaques in the streets in memory of Jews and other victims of Nazi atrocities.

articles.title_original: Security lapses at Utah campus where Charlie Kirk was killed, review says
articles.title_zh: Security lapses at Utah campus where Charlie Kirk was killed, review says
facts_zh:
Security lapses at Utah campus where Charlie Kirk was killed, review says
- Published
An independent review has pointed to a number of security shortcomings at the Utah campus where conservative activist Charlie Kirk was shot dead last year.

The report said Utah Valley University (UVU) did not carry out a proper written security assessment nor prepare an event action plan, deferring key decision-making about the event to Kirk's conservative organisation Turning Point USA.
It also said that Kirk's aides had insisted on a outdoor venue, overriding security concerns from campus officials, who then failed to properly assess the dangers.

all_titles.en: Security lapses at Utah campus where Charlie Kirk was killed, review says
